framework_lessons: Track income, total return, and relative return separately.
assessment: Bitcoin direction and the bond-yield rebound were strong calls. The BTI and BNS replacements outperformed BIPC in disclosed three- and five-year sensitivities. Scotiabank itself eventually delivered solid absolute returns but lagged SPY. The claims that reserve status requires trade deficits and equal weighting proves breadth need correction.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
